description: Saving canvas selections as reusable node templates, inserting them from the canvas menu, and managing, importing, and exporting them through the legacy dialog. Workflow templates are a separate capability.

characterizationScenarios.name: Saving, inserting, deleting, importing, and exporting preserve node template persistence

compatibilityPromises: The core extension remains the host integration seam for the canvas menu and template dialog.
Saved templates remain stored through the existing user data API.
